package.description: Resize any window to an exact, predefined size.

en-US.description: Resize any window to an exact, predefined size.
en-US.longDescription: Sizer is a utility to resize windows to exact dimensions. It is used by web designers, technical authors, developers and minecraft players, to exert control over where and how big application windows should be.
en-US.name: Sizer
